scope: Exact reversal of the reviewed camera-count and compact Fleet presentation changes before unchanged historical source guards. No baseline is relaxed. The Star4Live camera status tab is declared here as five reversible blocks: its import, its title, its tab, its view (which is handed the Fleet map’s own saved field addresses so both maps show the same places) and keeping the mHelp filter panel off it. The dashboard slogan and its eyebrow are removed: the page keeps one heading for screen readers and shows its section headings instead. The approved reading-scope presentation is declared as two additional reversible blocks: its stylesheet import and explanatory source/freshness section. Original baseline hashes and strict byte checks are preserved. Stacked on the theme branch: a board older than the current window keeps online and offline unknown, while a connection check that did not answer still holds the last reading inside that window. A present board keeps its last online, offline and unverified counts and labels them not current. A durable board that has not arrived, and a failed read, still cannot print a count. Phone width shows the technician to-do list and saved up, down and unknown counts first, and keeps the inventory identity card behind an info button. Desktop and TV keep that card visible. The map, briefing and camera status views load after first paint. Count labels split unverified into device-link and no-reading, keep name matches unverified, and a newer mHelp Field reading overrides an older app Shop move without deleting that move. Shared camera and camera-unit headlines use one selector. Shop stays out of those totals. Inventory unverified is listed by reason.
